request.subject: UNIT:RAIDER

layers.text: Redraw him as a high-medieval light horseman: the hooded riding cloak becomes deep crimson red with a gold-yellow trim along its edge and a gold clasp at the neck; a cream tunic with a dark brown leather belt; the saddle blanket deep crimson with a gold-yellow trim. Keep the sandy pony, the raised hand axe, the face, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hooves.
